dear future me: 

this is a messy solution to the fact that this project was originally set up to run on broadcasts, such that each sprite has to have a "hide" reaction for every page broadcast except its own. Initially, years ago, i planned for this by making a base sprite that had all broadcast scripts built in, and then just differentiated the sprites from this base sprite to ensure they all had the programming inside automatically. However, when plans changed, (aka i needed to add a new page for accs) now none of the sprites have anything telling them to hide when acc is clicked.

SO, to avoid having to drop a new script into every godforsaken sprite in this project telling it to go away when "acc" is clicked, I hijacked one of the broadcasts all the sprites are already programmed for ("fx icons") to get everything other than fx and acc to hide. then, to get fx to hide, i added a "if not fx, hide" variable script to all the fx sprites. which is messy and sort of tedious but sure as heck beats doing that to every sprite in the project.
